Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 700 PM EST Sun Nov 1 2026

- Mild and mostly cloudy through the early week.

- Near record warmth and breezy on Tuesday.

- Increasing likelihood for light rainfall on Wednesday.

&&

.AVIATION...

A surface low pivots toward the northern Plains tonight into Monday, 
sending a warm front and subsequent low level moisture into the 
Great Lakes Monday afternoon. As this occurs, winds veer from their 
current southeast direction to the south. A more impactful 
consequence of this is lowering ceilings, with ceilings reaching MVFR
by late afternoon and possibly IFR by 00z which is more likely for
southern terminals (DTW/YIP/DET). Current guidance suggests ceilings
will lower steadily and most aggressively between about 18z-00z,
which is slightly delayed compared to previous runs. 

For DTW...Gulf moisture lifts into SE Michigan Monday afternoon, 
bringing lowering ceilings to DTW. 5.0 kft ceilings are likely by 
mid-afternoon, with potential for ceilings to drop to low MVFR or 
IFR by Monday evening.  

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* High in ceilings aob 5000 ft early Monday afternoon and evening.
